articles.summary: Collaboration pairs Parallel Fluidics Flow Processing Units with the Opentrons Flex platform, giving labs end-to-end LNP workflows at 50X the throughput of common benchtop instruments BOSTON, MA and LONG ISLAND CITY, NY (November 19, 2026) – Parallel Fluidics and Opentrons Labworks Inc. today announced a collaboration to bring Flow Processing Units (FPUs) to the Opentrons […] The post Parallel Fluidics and Opentrons Team Up to Bring Automated Lipid Nanoparticle Formulation to the Opentrons Flex® appeared first on Opentrons .
articles.title: Parallel Fluidics and Opentrons Team Up to Bring Automated Lipid Nanoparticle Formulation to the Opentrons Flex®
